name: Pump
description: pump.fun memecoin launchpad on Solana. An agent can create coins on the Pump bonding-curve program, buy and sell coins on their bonding curve, migrate completed curves, and trade or provide liquidity on the PumpSwap AMM after migration.

keyFunctions.signature: create_v2(name: string, symbol: string, uri: string, creator: pubkey, is_mayhem_mode: bool, is_cashback_enabled?: bool, creator_fee_bps?: u16, is_holder_reward?: bool)
keyFunctions.description: Create a new coin as a Token-2022 mint (6 decimals) with its bonding curve. name <= 32 chars, symbol <= 13, uri <= 200. is_cashback_enabled is deprecated and must be false; creator_fee_bps applies only to custom-pair coins; trailing optional args may be omitted. Payer pays rent in SOL.

keyFunctions.signature: create(name: string, symbol: string, uri: string, creator: pubkey)
keyFunctions.description: Legacy coin creation (SPL Token + Metaplex metadata). creator is added to the metadata creators array and need not sign. Prefer create_v2.
Buy exactly `amount` coins (base units) from the bonding curve, spending at most max_sol_cost lamports. Legacy instruction, still works.
Sell exactly `amount` coins to the bonding curve for at least min_sol_output lamports. Legacy instruction, still works.

keyFunctions.signature: buy_v3(amount: u64, max_sol_cost: u64, partial_fill?: OptionBool)
keyFunctions.description: Newest buy: exact base amount out, max quote in (fees included). Supports non-SOL quote mints. partial_fill only applies to mayhem coins. Fails on cashback coins (use v2).

keyFunctions.signature: buy_exact_quote_in_v3(spendable_quote_in: u64, min_tokens_out: u64, partial_fill?: OptionBool)
keyFunctions.description: Spend an exact quote amount (fees included) for at least min_tokens_out coins.
Newest sell: exact base amount in, minimum quote out after fees.
v2 trade instructions; still supported and required for cashback coins (v3 rejects them with CashbackCoinNotSupported).
Permissionless, idempotent: move a completed bonding curve (real_token_reserves == 0) into a PumpSwap pool (index 0); LP tokens are burned.
Permissionless: sweep the creator vault (PDA ["creator-vault", creator]) to the creator. Not usable when the creator vault has moved to a Pump Fees sharing_config.
Read global config: fee recipients, initial curve parameters, fee bps, enable_migrate, pool_migration_fee.

Read virtual/real token and SOL reserves, token_total_supply, complete flag, creator, quote_mint, is_mayhem_mode. Used to quote prices off-chain (Uniswap-V2-style constant product on virtual reserves).
Buy exactly base_amount_out base tokens from a pool, paying at most max_quote_amount_in quote. Fees: 20 bps LP + 5 bps protocol (plus creator fee where applicable).
Sell exactly base_amount_in base tokens for at least min_quote_amount_out quote.
v2 trade instructions (same arguments; buy_exact_quote_in_v2(spendable_quote_in, min_base_amount_out)). v1 keeps working; cashback-coin pools must use v1.
Multi-hop swap across PumpSwap pools; see docs/instructions/MULTI_HOP_SWAP.md for accounts and args.

keyFunctions.signature: create_pool(index, creator, baseMint, quoteMint, baseIn, quoteIn)
keyFunctions.description: Create a pool for (base_mint, quote_mint); pool PDA from (index, creator, base_mint, quote_mint). Initial amounts set the price; creator receives LP tokens.
Mint exactly lp_token_amount_out LP tokens spending at most the given base/quote. No fee.
Burn LP tokens for at least the given base/quote. No fee.
Permissionless: sweep the coin creator vault ATA (authority PDA ["creator_vault", coin_creator]) to the creator's token account.
Read fee config and the 8 protocol_fee_recipients (pick one at random per buy/sell).
Read pool mints, vaults, lp_supply, coin_creator, virtual_quote_reserves. Effective quote reserves = quote vault balance + virtual_quote_reserves.
Compute the fee tier (protocol / LP / creator bps) that applies to a trade.
Set up creator fee sharing for a coin (moves creator fees to a sharing_config); see docs/instructions/CREATOR_FEE_SHARING.md.
Update the shareholders/shares of a fee sharing config (sharing authority only).

actions.name: launch-coin
actions.how: Pump program create_v2(name, symbol, uri, creator, is_mayhem_mode=false); or @pump-fun/pump-sdk helpers

actions.name: buy-on-curve
actions.description: Buy a coin still on its bonding curve
actions.how: Pump program buy_v3(amount, max_sol_cost) or buy_exact_quote_in_v3(spendable_quote_in, min_tokens_out); check BondingCurve.complete is false first

actions.name: sell-on-curve
actions.description: Sell a coin on its bonding curve

actions.name: migrate
actions.description: Graduate a completed curve to PumpSwap
actions.how: Pump program migrate() (permissionless) once BondingCurve.complete is true

actions.name: swap-after-graduation
actions.how: PumpSwap buy_v2/sell_v2/buy_exact_quote_in_v2 on the canonical pool (index 0); or @pump-fun/pump-swap-sdk

actions.name: add-liquidity
actions.how: PumpSwap deposit(lp_out, max_base_in, max_quote_in); remove with withdraw(lp_in, min_base_out, min_quote_out)

risks: Memecoins: extreme volatility, most coins go to ~zero; no vetting of creators.

Bonding-curve buys/sells pay a 100 bps base fee per the program README; PumpSwap charges 20 bps LP + 5 bps protocol plus a creator fee; actual fee tiers are dynamic (read via Pump Fees fee_config / get_fees or the SDK's computeFeesBps).
Coins created with create_v2 are Token-2022 mints; use the Token-2022 program (TokenzQdBNbLqP5VEhdkAS6EPFLC1PHnBqCXEpPxuEb) for their token accounts.

Programs are upgradeable by Pump; account layouts gain appended fields over time (missing trailing fields read as 0/false), and required accounts on buy/sell have changed before (e.g. fee accounts became mandatory Sept 2025). Build from the latest IDL/SDK.
Mayhem-mode and cashback coins behave differently (cashback coins must use v2 on the curve and v1 on PumpSwap; new cashback coins cannot be created).
notes: Only Solana is confirmed by Pump's official docs (both programs: same ID on mainnet and devnet). DefiLlama lists more chains for 'pump', but no official Pump source found confirming other deployments, so they are left out. Official IDLs: https://github.com/pump-fun/pump-public-docs/tree/main/idl (pump.json, pump_amm.json, pump_fees.json); official TypeScript SDKs @pump-fun/pump-sdk and @pump-fun/pump-swap-sdk. PumpSwap create_pool/deposit/withdraw signatures are written as in PUMP_SWAP_README.md (accounts and args mixed); check pump_amm.json for exact arg names/types. Other addresses from the docs: Mayhem program MAyhSmzXzV1pTf7LsNkrNwkWKTo4ougAJ1PPg47MD4e; Pump Fees fee_config for the Pump program 8Wf5TiAheLUqBrKXeYg2JtAFFMWtKdG2BSFgqUcPVwTt and for PumpSwap 5PHirr8joyTMp9JMm6nW7hNDVyEYdkzDqazxPD7RaTjx. PumpSwap protocol fee recipients are listed in PUMP_SWAP_README.md. No official public REST API is documented; the PUMP token mint was not confirmed from an official Pump source and is omitted.
